title: OpenCode Inference Service Configuration
description: Schema for individual inference service config YAML files in the fleet. Each file defines one service endpoint (supercat, tigerking, whiskerhead, etc.) that OpenCode can connect to.

service.description: Unique service identifier matching the node name (e.g., supercat, tigerking, whiskerhead)

inference_endpoint.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible inference endpoint (vLLM /v1 API)

model.description: Default model identifier served by this endpoint

api_key_env.description: Name of the environment variable containing the API key for this endpoint

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this service

tags.description: Optional tags for categorizing this service
